notes.title: Level Editor Patch
notes.content:
Added username input (needed for level competition, but noone will see it except me)
Fixed secondary cursor showing in Level Editor sometimes
Fixed sound bug when 2 mammals enter a hole at the same time
Fixed page loading error when browsing in Player-made levels

notes.title: New Level Editor + LEVEL COMPETITION!
notes.content:
Changes
- All new Level Editor: Make levels and share them with the world!
- Player Levels: Play levels made by other people!
- Reworked keyboard/controller support 
- Decreased amount of time needed for time-based achievements

Level Competition

[previewyoutube=1Gz6N5BAlJI;full][/previewyoutube]

How to participate
- Get Munchy Mammals (all platforms eligible!)
- Upload your level from the game before May 23rd
- Join the discord: https://discord.com/invite/7yxeeScN3G


Winners will be picked May 23rd!
- One winner is picked by me based on my own biased opinion.
- One winner is decided by amount of likes (whichever level is at the top of the "Most Liked"-category on May 23rd)
- The winners will be contacted through the server. If a winner doesn't respond for 7 days, the prize will be given to the runner-up.

The Prize
- Munchy Mammals bodypillow case (you may pick the color)
- A set of Munchy Mammals stickers
Note: Unfortunately due to transportation issues, we will not be giving away the pillow itself :(

notes.title: Little Things Update!
notes.content:
10+ new levels, 2 new achievements and lots of other cool changes!

This update was mostly focused on back-end stuff, so expect a smoother experience, but otherwise roughly the same game.

If you've already played through part of the game, you might find that the level selection screen looks a bit odd. This is normal. 
I added a lot of new levels in between old levels and also moved around preexisting levels to create a more gradual difficulty curve. 
Therefore you'll probably find a bunch of unplayed levels in between your already completed levels. 

Patch notes

 added/modified a lot of levels
 added Lose UI (indicate leftover food/goals)
 added new achievements
 added new main menu
 expanded options
 new save system
 added a way to reset your save from in game
 fixed a bunch of bugs

notes.title: Post Release Fixes!
notes.content:
This update is mainly just bug fixes with a few UX enhancements thrown in. 
Thank you for your feedback!


 Better level selection. 
- Your last played level will now be selected when returning to level menu.
- When using keyboard/controller level buttons rise, to make your selected level clearer
- You can now scroll the level menu using the right stick
 Save now happens every time you finish a level (crashing won't delete your progress)
 You can now also use 'Space' to go to next level
 Fixed typos
